brief:
Israeli occupation forces notified Palestinian Iyad Ajaj on Sunday of plans to demolish his house in the al-Mohammadi neighborhood of Shuweika suburb, north of Tulkarem city, according to Shehab Wire. The demolition order was issued following Ajaj's displacement from Tulkarem refugee camp.

Local sources confirmed receipt of the notification, which targets a residential structure in an area that has faced repeated Israeli military operations. The order represents the latest in a series of demolition notices issued against Palestinian properties in the northern West Bank region, where displacement and home destruction have intensified pressure on civilian populations.
